correctness.rationale: The statement for at most two imbalanced self-borders follows exactly from the established weighted cluster generating function. Its entropy polynomial H=(x-2)sum_{border j}x^(j-1)+1 is monic with constant ±1. The growth root λ>1 is therefore an algebraic unit and no λ^d, d>=1, is rational. Implicit differentiation gives rho=1/2 exactly when sum (j-2c_j)λ^j vanishes; cancellation among at most two nonzero integer monomials is impossible. The simple dominant root follows for the stipulated primitive one-word shift. Two independent calculations agree in 426 finite patterns and three examples; computation is only corroboration.
